rules: Use extremely tight letter spacing for headings.
Never center-align large blocks of text; stick to left-alignment for strong editorial structure.
Use mono font for overlines, tags, and tech specs.

visual_enhancers.noise_texture: A fixed overlay with a subtle black and white noise texture (mix-blend-overlay or opacity 3-5%) to kill the 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.custom_cursor: A custom circular cursor that follows the mouse, blending with the background (mix-blend-difference) or glowing subtly when hovering over interactable elements.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. For the sticky header or floating cards, use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px solid border-border_subtle and a very faint white background (bg-white/5).
visual_enhancers.glow: Use radial gradients in the background to create 'auras' behind key elements like the 3D sphere or CTA buttons. Use the primary ORION blue.

layouts_and_sections.global: Wrap the entire site in a Lenis smooth scroll provider. Set background to background_base.
layouts_and_sections.preloader: An animated full-screen preloader that reveals the ORION logo or text sequentially before fading out and allowing the Hero animation to start.

hero.content: Eyebrow ('Proactive AI Operating Network'), massive 'ORION' title (masked line-by-line reveal), subtitle. Two magnetic buttons.
hero.3d_element: React Three Fiber particle sphere or network on the right side or background, reacting to mouse position (rotation/parallax).

about.interaction: Scroll storytelling. Large text reveals letter-by-letter or word-by-word on scroll. Pin & reveal effect for the domains (Automation, System Interaction, etc.).

features.design: Massive typography for the numbers (e.g., text-8xl text-border_subtle). Clean bento-style or full-width rows with high contrast.

how_it_works.layout: Horizontal scroll section OR sticky pinned vertical scroll revealing steps one by one.
how_it_works.steps: User Input → AI Analysis → Tool Selection → Execution → Feedback.

tech_stack.layout: Slow editorial marquee for the tech stack items.
tech_stack.design: Large outline text or prominent typography sliding infinitely across the screen.

contact.layout: Deep dark brutalist or glassmorphic form for lead capture.
contact.interaction: Form inputs must have focus glows and micro-interactions.

motion_and_interactions.reveal: Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (fade up, line-by-line mask reveals).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Magnetic buttons (the button slightly moves towards the cursor on hover), hover glows.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable 3D reactivity and complex Framer Motion transitions if true.

3d_libraries.usage: Create a signature 3D particle brain/sphere in the Hero. Use points/particles, apply a custom shader or simple math for undulating motion, and use useFrame to rotate it slightly based on state.mouse.

texture_overlay.description: Grainy black and white abstract texture for the fixed background noise overlay.

abstract_particles_fallback.description: Abstract dust particles, useful as a fallback image if WebGL fails or for meta tags.

components_and_tech.forms: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the structure to maintain the highly custom cinematic look, or heavily stripped-down Shadcn components.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and WebGL.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully with backdrop-blur.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
NEVER use generic placeholder images or AI assistant Emojis.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays that have content under it. Use dark semi-transparent with backdrop-blur.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the preloader is fully functional before revealing the hero.
Implement the React Three Fiber particle sphere prominently in the hero section. Use Points and PointsMaterial or a custom shader.
Implement the lead capture form so it's ready to be hooked up to a MongoDB backend (create an API route in FastAPI).
Follow the exact site content provided. Do not invent new copy.
Ensure horizontal scroll for 'How It Works' works smoothly via Framer Motion useScroll and useTransform.
